page_title: OVI 0-1 ATM | Oviedo v Atletico Madrid 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' 0 - 1 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
90+3' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
88' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
85' Golden opportunity! Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
83' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
83' Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Alberto Reina limps off the pitch to be replaced by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo).
80' Substitution. Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) in, Nacho Vidal out.
78' Looks like Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
76' Some neat passing and movement from Oviedo as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
74' The statistic for corner kicks – 7:2.
72' A substitution has been made. Ilyas Chaira goes off and Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) comes on.
72' Here is a change. Haissem Hassan is going off and Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves gives the last tactical orders to Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo).
72' Substitution. Thiago Almada is replaced by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
71' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card!
71' It's like he was asking for a caution. Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) receives a yellow card.
70' Koke (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
68' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
65' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) replaces Nicolas Fonseca.
64' The attendance is 27067.
63' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) was in a good position to shoot around the penalty spot after a nice pass, but his effort was unintentionally blocked by one of his teammates.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Johnny Cardoso can be given a rest.
61' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Alexander Sorloth will be replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Koke (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch for Rodrigo Mendoza.
60' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' Oviedo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
56' The ball possession at the moment is 39:61.
54' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
53' Julio Diaz (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
51' Oviedo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
49' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
47' It looks like Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Cesar Soto Grado won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) and Ademola Lookman is off.
46' Referee Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Oviedo take a short corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
44' Oviedo have a corner.
42' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
41' Oviedo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo).
38' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Soto Grado no option but to blow his whistle.
37' A player from Oviedo commits a rough challenge. Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
35' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
33' Julio Diaz (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
32' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
30' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
28' The total number of attempts is 5:4.
26' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) trips an opposition player and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul.
25' A spell of possession for Atl. Madrid in an attempt to control the game.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.

23' A fine pass finds Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Jan Oblak reacts superbly to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Oviedo.
22' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
19' Corner kick. Oviedo will have an opportunity.
19' Oviedo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
18' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) and blew his whistle.
16' The possession of the ball – 33:67.
14' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
12' Atl. Madrid exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
10' Good defending. Julio Diaz (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Ademola Lookman inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
8' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Cesar Soto Grado saw the whole situation.
6' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
5' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner.

3' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Cesar Soto Grado.
